rules: Use large typography for plain-language accessibility.
Never center-align paragraphs; left-align for readability.
Headings must use tight letter spacing.
Do not use generic fonts if custom fonts are requested, but default to readable System fonts for mobile security apps.
Adhere to 'Light Sentinel' visual system: clean, light-themed, high contrast, secure feel.
Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.

visual enhancers.shadows: Subtle, ambient shadows for cards to indicate elevation without clutter.
visual enhancers.radius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-full for buttons.

grids: Bento grid for Hub sections if applicable, but mostly vertical stack for standard mobile views.

layouts.RootNavigation: Bottom tab bar: Home | Higgins | Gates | Check It | Patrol
layouts.Header: Shared top-right Settings action. Fix Settings double tap/back state.
layouts.GateCard: One card per Gate. Vertical layout: Purpose, Current Status, Attention Item, Action.
layouts.PatrolScreen: Five-state summary at top. Horizontal filter bar: 'All activity, Needs you, Warnings, Threats stopped, Resolved'. Vertical list of PatrolCards.
layouts.HigginsHub: Independent vertical sections: Ask Higgins, Continue live work, Recent investigations, New scams, Learn with Higgins, Saved reports/explanations.
layouts.HigginsChat: Child screen for ordinary-chat transcript that preserves hub state when navigated back.
layouts.LearningReader: Backend-driven list/detail reader with explicit offline/error states.
layouts.InvestigationHistory: Vertical list with search bar, filters, and pagination controls.

motion.interactions: Clear opacity/scale feedback on touchable elements.

accessibility: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Clear distinction of states (Needs action vs Information).

media.images: Minimal. Focus on clear typography and state indicators.
media.icons: Lucide React Native for explicit, simple metaphors.

3d libraries.usage: None. Keep the UI flat, fast, and accessible.

instructions_to_main_agent: Preserve the exact root navigation order: Home | Higgins | Gates | Check It | Patrol.
Settings remains the shared top-right action. Fix navigation guard so double taps resolve properly and Back preserves tab state.
Gate cards: Render exactly one card per Gate containing purpose, what Apollo is doing now, genuine attention item, and one action.
Patrol filters: Implement exactly 'All activity, Needs you, Warnings, Threats stopped, Resolved'.
Higgins hub: Create independently loading sections for Ask Higgins, continue live work, recent investigations, New scams, Learn with Higgins, and saved reports/explanations.
Learning client: Build a no-store reader. Article bodies MUST NOT ship in the consumer bundle. Implement offline and error states.
New Scams reader: Incorporate ACSC and Scamwatch advice.
Investigation history: Implement search, filters, pagination, and delete actions.
Do not invent new product requirements, web-only UI, admin UI inside the consumer app, or technical diagnostics on consumer cards.
Use .js files instead of .tsx for React Native components.
Do not use Playwright, browser journeys, scenarios, testing agents, live Gemini, or runtime mocks.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs; avoid this by creating crisp, highly accessible mobile interfaces.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle shadows.
Never apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Use modern button styles relevant to the app style.
Avoid using Emoji characters for icons.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Focus on Emotion First: The app should feel protective, clear, and reassuring.
Use generous spacing (2-3x more than typical) to prevent accidental taps and improve legibility.
Ensure contrast checks pass for all text on colored backgrounds.
Buttons should explicitly describe the action (e.g., 'View official advice', 'Ask Higgins about this').
